method.samples: all 1441, including scheduled windows; original verifier excluded 5 planned samples
method.medians: Same beginning/final count as verifier: min(15,max(1,n//4)); hourly bins anchored to run start; include partial bins explicitly by sample count. Halves split covered time, not sample index. All sizes bytes. No new MiB acceptance threshold.
method.clock: Bridge receipt times paired with target monotonic per sample. Linear interpolation for target journal correlation; receipt latency is unmeasured, so bridge mappings are estimates, not exact synchronization. Mechanisms are also checked in same-clock target sequences and raw host cycle windows.
method.rss: RSS includes shared mappings; do not sum child RSS as private physical memory. SReclaimable is part of Slab; Cached equals Shmem here and is not evidence of freely reclaimable disk cache.
